hook: A Google AI lead got *Windows 11 running on an iPhone Duo*, with Gemini's help
caption:
Ammaar Reshi, who leads product and design for Google AI Studio, booted full Windows 11 on Apple's foldable iPhone Duo, no jailbreak.
The top screen shows the Windows desktop and the bottom half works as a keyboard and trackpad.
He said Gemini 4 Carbon agents worked on it for about two hours. It is an experiment: setup needs a Mac with Xcode and your own Windows image.

Would you use your phone as a tiny Windows laptop?
